title: Core data services start with one compose command
user_visible_behavior: `docker compose up -d --wait` starts PostgreSQL (with pgvector), MinIO and Mailpit with healthchecks and named volumes; `./init.sh` reports them healthy.
verification: docker compose up -d --wait exits 0 and all services report healthy
psql inside the postgres container runs `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector` successfully
MinIO console and Mailpit UI answer on their published ports
./init.sh runs the compose health check and exits 0
notes: Prerequisite: developer installs Docker Engine + Compose v2 (sudo pacman). Pinned image tags. Volumes should live on a data NVMe (docs/technical-discovery.md). Keycloak and AI services are separate features.

title: Local MoE LLM and SDXL ControlNet run on the GPU in containers
user_visible_behavior: llama-server (MoE model, experts in RAM) and ComfyUI (SDXL + ControlNet Depth/Canny) run as compose services on the RX 9070 XT; a measurement report records VRAM, tokens/s and seconds per image.
verification: curl to llama-server /v1/chat/completions returns a completion and valid JSON under a JSON schema constraint
A ComfyUI API workflow turns a sample kitchen photo into an SDXL + ControlNet Depth image
Peak VRAM with both services loaded is recorded and stays under ~14.5 GB, or the serialization need is documented
Results recorded in PROGRESS.md and ADR 0001 status updated
notes: Day-1 spike (docs/risks-and-open-questions.md). Try ROCm images first (gfx1201 needs ROCm >= 6.4), Vulkan fallback for llama.cpp. Decide model/quant; fall back to SD 1.5 if SDXL is too slow. Spike output is compose services + report, no app code.

title: NestJS API answers health and exposes OpenAPI
user_visible_behavior: pnpm monorepo with apps/api (NestJS + Prisma on PostgreSQL) runs in compose; GET /health reports DB status and /docs serves the OpenAPI spec.
verification: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile succeeds
pnpm -r lint and pnpm -r test pass (at least one API test)
curl /health returns 200 with database: up
./init.sh upgraded to the bootstrapped variant and passes
notes: ADR 0003. Shared packages/ for types. Upgrade init.sh to the bootstrapped variant in this feature.

title: Installable PWA shell with design tokens and en/es i18n
user_visible_behavior: apps/web (Next.js + Tailwind with DESIGN.md tokens) serves an installable home screen in English or Spanish chosen from the browser language, and shows API health.
verification: Lighthouse PWA installability passes on the home screen
Browser language es shows Spanish strings, en shows English
Home screen calls the API health endpoint through the generated client
Playwright smoke test at 390x844 passes
notes: UI gate: design the home screen in design/openpencil/bricomission_B2C_app.fig via open-pencil MCP before implementing. Remaining 9 locales are feature i18n-all-locales.

title: Keycloak realm issues tokens the API authorizes by role
user_visible_behavior: Keycloak runs in compose with realm BricoMission (roles user, professional, admin, seeded admin and demo accounts); API endpoints reject requests without a valid token or with the wrong role.
verification: Realm is imported from a versioned JSON on container start
API test: request without token -> 401, user token on admin route -> 403, admin token -> 200
Email OTP configured with Mailpit as SMTP
notes: docs/user-and-access-model.md. Secrets via .env (git-ignored) with .env.example committed. Google SSO is a later feature.

title: Homeowner signs in with password and email OTP
user_visible_behavior: From the PWA a Homeowner registers or signs in through Keycloak with username/password and an email OTP delivered to Mailpit, and lands back signed in.
verification: Playwright: register, read OTP from Mailpit API, complete login, see signed-in state
Works with the network disabled
notes: OIDC Authorization Code + PKCE. Keycloak login theme styled with DESIGN.md tokens (UI gate applies).

title: Anonymous visitor uploads kitchen photos and measurements
user_visible_behavior: Without an account, a visitor creates a draft Kitchen Project, uploads photos (stored in MinIO) and enters length x width x height; the draft survives a page reload.
verification: API test: anonymous draft creation, photo upload to MinIO, measurement validation (positive numbers, sane ranges)
Playwright at 390x844: upload two photos, enter measurements, reload, data still shown
notes: UI gate: Photo Upload + Measurements screen. Anonymous drafts bound to a browser session token; 7-day cleanup is an assumption.

title: Visitor builds a Moodboard from references
user_visible_behavior: The visitor uploads own reference photos or picks from a curated style gallery, selects favorites, and the Moodboard is saved on the draft.
verification: Playwright: add one uploaded and two gallery images, deselect one, reload, Moodboard intact
API test: Moodboard belongs to the draft and rejects foreign drafts
notes: UI gate: Moodboard screen. Prompt-to-image reference generation is out of this slice (costly AI, needs the Login Gate).

title: Costly AI action requires login and claims the draft
user_visible_behavior: When an anonymous visitor requests a Render or a Budget, the Login Gate appears; after signing in, the same draft Kitchen Project now belongs to the new Homeowner.
verification: Playwright: anonymous draft -> press Generate -> login -> back on the draft, owned by the account
API test: costly endpoints return 401 for anonymous sessions; claim is idempotent and refuses drafts of other sessions
notes: docs/domain-model.md Kitchen Project lifecycle draft -> claimed.

title: API serializes GPU jobs and streams their status
user_visible_behavior: AI requests go through one API job broker: image jobs run one at a time, chat waits while the GPU is busy, and clients receive queued/running/done status over SSE.
verification: Test with fake AI adapters: two image jobs never overlap; chat request during an image job is queued then served
SSE endpoint emits ordered status events for a job
AI adapters are behind interfaces with deterministic fakes
notes: docs/technical-discovery.md GPU Serialization. Queue technology (BullMQ+Redis vs Postgres) decided in the spec. Endpoints read from platform settings (default: compose service URLs).

title: Homeowner gets a photorealistic Render that keeps the room geometry
user_visible_behavior: A signed-in Homeowner requests a Render; ComfyUI SDXL + ControlNet produces an image from their photo and Moodboard, stored in MinIO and shown with a before/after slider.
verification: Integration run on the real GPU: one Render produced from a sample photo within the measured time budget
Visual check: window, door and plumbing positions match the source photo (screenshot evidence)
API test with fake adapter covers storage and ownership
notes: UI gate: AI Results screen (render part). Quota checks are added by daily-quota-enforcement.

title: Catalog PDFs are searchable in the local RAG index
user_visible_behavior: An ingestion command chunks and embeds the partner Catalog PDFs into pgvector; a search endpoint returns relevant chunks with document and page references.
verification: Ingestion of the sample Catalog PDFs completes and reports chunk counts
Search for a known product returns the chunk containing its SKU and price, with page reference
Re-running ingestion is idempotent
notes: Developer supplies Catalog PDFs (curated offline with NotebookLM). Check text layer vs scanned. Embedding model choice in spec.

title: Homeowner receives four verified Budget Tiers
user_visible_behavior: For a claimed Kitchen Project, the system returns Luxury/High/Medium/Low tiers whose Line Items cite Catalog sources; every unit price is verified against the source chunk and all totals are computed by code.
verification: Unit tests: decimal computation of subtotals, tier totals and VAT
Unit test: a Line Item whose cited price is absent from its chunk is rejected
Same Line Items recomputed twice give identical totals
Integration run with the real LLM on a sample project produces four tiers
notes: ADR 0002. Schema-constrained JSON output from llama-server. UI gate: Budget Tier Overview screen.

title: Homeowner refines the Budget by chat with a switchable Persona
user_visible_behavior: The Homeowner chats about materials; answers stream in the selected Persona's voice; switching Persona changes the tone of the next answer; Line Item changes recompute totals in code.
verification: Test: four Persona system prompts selectable; switching does not alter totals
Playwright with fake LLM: send message, see streamed answer, switch Persona, next answer tagged with new Persona
Chat responds in the user's locale
notes: UI gate: AI Results & Chat screen with Persona dropdown.

title: UI controls adjust the Budget through Prompt Macros
user_visible_behavior: Selecting a tier or changing a material in a dropdown sends a structured hidden prompt to the chat, and the Budget updates through the same verified Line Item path.
verification: Test: each control emits the expected structured prompt and no client-side math exists
Playwright with fake LLM: change countertop material -> Budget total changes to the code-computed value
notes: Prompt Macro definition in CONTEXT.md.

title: Homeowner downloads the DIY Shopping List PDF
user_visible_behavior: From a selected tier the Homeowner downloads a PDF with exact products, SKUs, quantities, unit prices, sources and totals; the Kitchen Project moves to diy_completed.
verification: PDF text extraction test: totals and SKUs match the stored Budget
PDF stored in MinIO and downloadable only by its owner
notes: UI gate: DIY Partner Selection screen.

title: Homeowner publishes a locked Dossier
user_visible_behavior: The Homeowner publishes the project to the Marketplace; an immutable Dossier snapshot (Renders, Measurements, chosen tier, Line Items) is created with an open Bidding Window.
verification: API test: Dossier content cannot be modified after publication
API test: window end = publication time + configured duration; expiry job moves it to expired
Republishing an expired Dossier creates a new one
notes: Bidding Window default 15 days, read from platform settings when admin-marketplace-settings exists.

title: Professional registers with a Tax ID and waits for validation
user_visible_behavior: A Professional signs up with corporate email, Company legal name and Tax ID (CIF or NIF, format-validated); the account is pending_validation and sees a waiting screen.
verification: Unit tests: CIF and NIF format/checksum validation
Playwright: registration ends on the pending screen; Dossier routes return 403
notes: Self-employed = one-member Company with NIF. UI gate: design in bricomission_B2B_dashboard.fig.

title: Administrator validates pending Professionals
user_visible_behavior: The Admin Dashboard lists pending Professionals; the Administrator approves (creating or linking a Company by Tax ID) or rejects them, and the Professional's access changes accordingly.
verification: Playwright as admin: approve one, reject one; approved user gains Dossier access, rejected does not
API test: a second Professional with an existing Tax ID is linked, not duplicated
notes: First Admin Dashboard screen: UI gate with design/openpencil/bricomission_admin.fig.

title: Administrator edits marketplace settings
user_visible_behavior: The Administrator sets Bidding Window duration, Platform Commission %, minimum delay penalty and Payment Mode from the dashboard; new Dossiers and Contracts use the saved values.
verification: Playwright as admin: change window to 10 minutes, publish a Dossier, its end time reflects 10 minutes
API test: non-admin cannot read or write settings
notes: Defaults: 15 days, 5 %, 50 EUR/day, Simulated.

title: Validated Professionals see open Dossiers and their Company's work
user_visible_behavior: A Professional of a validated Company sees all open Dossiers, plus the Company's Kitchen Projects: own ones editable, co-workers' read-only.
verification: API tests for the permission matrix in docs/user-and-access-model.md
Playwright: two Professionals of one Company see each other's projects with correct edit/read-only state
notes: UI gate: B2B Contractor Dashboard.

title: Company submits and revises one Bid per Dossier
user_visible_behavior: A Professional submits a Bid (price, guaranteed installation date, delay penalty >= minimum) on an open Dossier and can revise it while open; co-workers see it read-only; each revision is versioned.
verification: API test: second Bid from the same Company rejected; co-worker cannot edit
API test: revision creates a new version; edits refused once the Dossier is not open
Penalty below the platform minimum is rejected
notes: UI gate: B2B Bid Submission screen.

title: Homeowner compares anonymous Bids and accepts one
user_visible_behavior: The Homeowner sees Bids with price, date, penalty and rating but no Company identity, and accepts one; the Dossier closes and other Bids become not_selected.
verification: API test: Bid DTO for Homeowners contains no Company identifiers
API test: acceptance binds to the Bid version shown; concurrent revision does not change it
Playwright: accept a Bid, Dossier shows accepted
notes: UI gate: Marketplace Bidding Dashboard (B2C). Ratings are seeded demo data.

title: Homeowner gets live alerts for new and lowered Bids
user_visible_behavior: While viewing the Dossier, the Homeowner receives an SSE alert and the list updates when a Bid arrives or its price drops.
verification: Playwright with two browser contexts: Professional lowers price, Homeowner sees toast and updated price without reload
SSE reconnect resumes without duplicate alerts
notes: SSE only, no external push services. Alerts announced via ARIA live region (DESIGN.md).

title: Accepted Bid produces a Contract PDF with penalties and commission
user_visible_behavior: On acceptance a Contract PDF is generated with parties, scope, price, installation date, code-computed delay penalty clause and Platform Commission, stored in MinIO with its SHA-256.
verification: Unit tests: penalty and commission amounts computed with decimal arithmetic
PDF text extraction matches stored amounts; stored hash equals file hash
notes: UI gate: Digital Contract / PDF View screen. Spanish legal wording; contract language follows the Homeowner locale when available.

title: Both parties accept the Contract electronically
user_visible_behavior: The Homeowner and the managing Professional re-authenticate and accept; evidence (who, when, IP, PDF hash) is recorded and appended; the Contract becomes binding and Company identity is revealed to the Homeowner.
verification: Playwright: both acceptances in either order lead to binding
API test: acceptance without recent re-authentication is refused
Company identity appears only after binding
notes: Electronic Acceptance in CONTEXT.md. UI gate: B2B Contract Signing screen.

title: Company settles the commission in Simulated Payment Mode
user_visible_behavior: With Payment Mode Simulated, the Professional completes the commission checkout offline and the Contract moves from commission_pending to commission_paid.
verification: Playwright with network disabled: checkout completes and status updates
API test: amount equals the Contract commission
notes: Default Payment Mode.

title: Company settles the commission through PayPal Sandbox
user_visible_behavior: With Payment Mode PayPal, checkout redirects to PayPal Sandbox and the Contract is marked commission_paid after capture.
verification: Online run with sandbox buyer account: capture confirmed and status updated
API test with mocked PayPal client covers success and cancel
notes: Requires online network and PayPal Sandbox credentials in .env. Offline fallback is Simulated.

title: Costly AI calls respect the Daily Quota
user_visible_behavior: When the Quota Flag is on, each Homeowner's LLM calls and image generations are counted per day and blocked with a clear message once the limit is reached; free actions keep working.
verification: API tests: counter increments per call type, resets at local midnight, blocks at limit, ignored when the flag is off
Playwright: limit 1 image -> second Render request shows the quota message
notes: Usage also feeds the Admin token/image usage view.

title: Administrator overrides or resets a user's quota
user_visible_behavior: The Administrator views per-user and per-service usage, sets a custom daily limit for a user, and resets a user's daily counter to zero.
verification: Playwright as admin: reset a blocked user's counter -> user's next Render succeeds
API test: override takes precedence over the global limit
notes: Critical for continuous demos.

title: Administrator manages platform users
user_visible_behavior: The Administrator lists, searches, creates, edits, disables and deletes users of any role; disabling revokes sessions.
verification: Playwright as admin: create, edit, disable a user; disabled user's next API call returns 401
API test: Keycloak and local profile stay consistent
notes: Revocation rules in docs/user-and-access-model.md.

title: Administrator hot-swaps AI endpoints and storage credentials
user_visible_behavior: The Administrator edits LLM, image and embedding endpoint URLs/models and MinIO connection credentials from the dashboard, tests the connection, and the API uses the new values without restart or .env edits.
verification: Playwright as admin: switch LLM endpoint to a second server, test connection, next chat uses it
Secrets stored encrypted at rest and never returned in clear to the UI
notes: Enables swapping to a cloud endpoint or an Avalon experiment (ADR 0001).

title: Homeowner signs in with Google when online
user_visible_behavior: The login screen offers Google sign-in through Keycloak; with no network the password option still works.
verification: Online run: Google sign-in completes and creates a Homeowner account
Offline run: Google button degrades gracefully, password login works
notes: Requires Google OAuth client credentials in .env. Apple SSO and SMS OTP are non-goals.

title: App is available in all 11 locales with language persistence
user_visible_behavior: All UI strings exist in en, es, fr, de, it, pt, nl, sv, no, da, fi; unsupported browser languages see the Language Selection screen (English default); the choice is saved on the account.
verification: Test: no missing keys in any locale
Playwright: browser locale ja shows Language Selection; choosing de persists after logout/login
Visual check of the longest strings (de, fi) on 360px width
notes: UI gate: Language Selection screen. Run late so all strings exist.
